## 2026

**9 September  — AISP Intermediate Conference 2026:**
I presented **“Health and environment: factors influencing public awareness”** at the AISP Intermediate Conference *Population and Health: Mortality and Morbidity Inequalities in Demographic and Environmental Dynamics*, held at the Italian Geographical Society in Rome.


**New article in Scientific Reports:** *Temporal trends in cardiovascular disease and diabetes prevalence in the United States: assessing compression versus expansion* was published in *Scientific Reports*.

**Article accepted in Statistics in Medicine:** *Modeling heterogeneity in health risk behaviors with a dynamic mixture model informed by textual occupational data* was accepted for publication.

**SIS–FENStatS 2026:**   Presentation of work on national well-being documents and their links with environmental dimensions at the Joint Meeting SIS–FENStatS in Rome.
